commands: if [ -f /app/moodle/config.php ]; then DBHOST=$(awk -F"'" '/\$CFG->dbhost/{print $2}' /app/moodle/config.php); DBNAME=$(awk -F"'" '/\$CFG->dbname/{print $2}' /app/moodle/config.php); DBUSER=$(awk -F"'" '/\$CFG->dbuser/{print $2}' /app/moodle/config.php); DBPASS=$(awk -F"'" '/\$CFG->dbpass/{print $2}' /app/moodle/config.php); VAL=$(mariadb -h "$DBHOST" -u "$DBUSER" -p"$DBPASS" -D "$DBNAME" -N -B -e "SELECT value FROM mdl_config WHERE name='maxbytes';" 2>/dev/null || true); echo "maxbytes=${VAL:-unknown}"; else echo "maxbytes=unknown"; fi
